chapters.title: Platform, not just a set of tools

takeaways: Power Platform is an enterprise platform that happens to be accessible, so tenants need deliberate setup instead of open default settings.
Governance built on clarity, confidence and explained boundaries speeds up makers and reduces shadow IT, while overly bureaucratic processes drive people away.
Start with an inventory, structure environments, and use DLP policies, tenant settings, roles and ALM where solutions become business critical.
hook: Many organizations either leave Power Platform wide open or bury makers in approvals. In this interview, Microsoft MVP Michael Roth explains to admins and platform owners how inventory, environments, DLP policies and clearly explained boundaries make governance an enabler for citizen developers rather than a brake on innovation.
